title: Penalty for pushing or scraping a putt
question: What is the penalty if you push or scrape your ball along the green with your putter instead of making a proper stroke?

choices.text: Replay the shot with no penalty

explanation: Pushing or scraping a ball along the putting green rather than making a recognised stroke results in a two-stroke penalty.

juniorVersion.title: Penalty for not hitting your putt properly
juniorVersion.question: If you use your putter to push or scrape the ball along the green instead of making a normal putt, what is the penalty?

choices.text: You get two extra shots added to your score
You take the shot again with no penalty
You get one extra shot added

juniorVersion.explanation: If you push or scrape your ball with your putter instead of making a proper stroke, you get two extra shots added to your score.

vocabulary.simpleMeaning: A soft shot played with a putter to roll the ball on the green towards the hole.
The golf club you use on the green to roll the ball into the hole.
A regular hit or swing at the ball with a club.

juniorVersion.teachingTip: Show what a proper putt looks like by letting kids try both a correct putt and a push/scrape, then explain why the rule is important for fairness.
likelyMisconceptions: Thinking that pushing or scraping the ball is the same as a normal putt.
Believing there is no penalty for not doing a proper stroke.
